en.headline: Victoria Park Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival opens Thursday
en.dek: The free display organised by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department runs from 17 to 27 September, featuring Hong Kong-themed lanterns and a large banyan-tree installation by the Tourism Board.
body: The Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival at Victoria Park will open on Thursday, 17 September, and continue until 27 September, the Leisure and Cultural Services Department has announced.

Lanterns on soccer pitches No. 1 to 6 are designed around Hong Kong’s distinct flavour, culinary culture and everyday scenes. A large-scale installation called Shadowlight, presented by the Hong Kong Tourism Board, features an illuminated eight-metre banyan tree crafted by Nanjing artisans.

Lighting-up time is 6.30pm to 11pm, extended to midnight on 25 September, the Mid-Autumn Festival day itself. Admission is free. A creative market will operate during the same hours, and the carnival forms part of the Chinese Culture Festival programmes.

Visitors are advised that naked-flame lanterns, alcoholic drinks and certain other items are prohibited. On peak nights temporary crowd measures may be applied. A separate Mid-Autumn lighting installation continues at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza until 11 October.

zh.headline: 維園中秋綵燈會周四起舉行至27日
zh.dek: 康文署主辦的免費綵燈展以香港特色為題，旅發局呈獻八米榕樹裝置「影光」，亮燈時間傍晚6時半至11時。
body: 康樂及文化事務署宣布，維多利亞公園中秋綵燈會將於9月17日（周四）至27日舉行。
一至六號足球場展出以香港特色、飲食文化及日常場景為題的綵燈。香港旅遊發展局呈獻大型裝置「影光」，為南京工匠製作的八米高發光榕樹。
亮燈時間為晚上6時30分至11時，中秋正日9月25日延長至午夜。入場免費。同期設有創意市集，活動亦屬中華文化節節目之一。
場內禁止明火燈籠、酒精飲品等物品。高峰時段或實施人流管制。香港文化中心露天廣場的中秋光影裝置則繼續展出至10月11日。
